definitions.explanation: A flying insect with a long body and two pairs of transparent wings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{蜻蛉|とんぼ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}んでいる→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
{蜻蛉|とんぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえようとした→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧。
examples.english: I tried to catch a dragonfly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{赤蜻蛉|あかとんぼ}→赤蜻蛉：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: In autumn, you can see many red dragonflies.

examples.japanese: {蜻蛉|とんぼ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぐるぐる→ぐるぐる：05160_guruguru⟧⟦{飛|と}んでいる→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: Dragonflies are flying in circles above the pond.
A swarm of dragonflies was flying over the rice paddies at dusk.

notes:
{蜻蛉|とんぼ} is associated with late summer and autumn in Japan.

SPECIES:
- ⟦{赤蜻蛉|あかとんぼ}→赤蜻蛉：noentry⟧: red dragonfly (symbol of autumn)
- ⟦オニヤンマ→オニヤンマ：noentry⟧: giant dragonfly
- ⟦シオカラトンボ→シオカラトンボ：noentry⟧: common skimmer

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Symbol of autumn and victory (doesn't fly backward)
- Featured in the famous children's song '⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧とんぼ'
- Called '⟦{勝|か}ち{虫|むし}→勝ち虫：noentry⟧' (victory insect) by samurai

KANJI NOTE: Often written in hiragana (とんぼ). The kanji {蜻蛉|とんぼ} can also be read as 'かげろう' (mayfly).
